SELECT product.*, required_grade.grade_name AS required_grade_name FROM T_LON_PROD_M product INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A required_grade ON product.required_grade_id = required_grade.grade_id WHERE product.id = #{id} AND product.is_active = TRUE

SELECT enrollment.id AS enrollment_id, product.id AS product_id, 'DEPOSIT' AS product_type, product.kor_co_nm AS financial_company_name, product.name AS product_name, enrollment.status AS enrollment_status, enrollment.applied_rate, enrollment.applied_early_termination_rate, enrollment.term_months, enrollment.start_date, enrollment.maturity_date, enrollment.closed_at, enrollment.created_at AS requested_at, wallet.balance AS deposit_amount FROM T_DPT_ENROLL_M enrollment INNER JOIN T_DPT_PROD_M product ON enrollment.deposit_id = product.id INNER JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M wallet ON enrollment.wallet_id = wallet.id WHERE enrollment.child_id = #{childId} AND enrollment.status <> 'REJECTED' ORDER BY enrollment.created_at DESC, enrollment.id DESC

SELECT enrollment.id AS enrollment_id, product.id AS product_id, 'SAVING' AS product_type, product.kor_co_nm AS financial_company_name, product.name AS product_name, enrollment.status AS enrollment_status, enrollment.applied_rate, enrollment.applied_early_termination_rate, enrollment.term_months, enrollment.monthly_amount, enrollment.payment_day, enrollment.auto_transfer, enrollment.start_date, enrollment.maturity_date, enrollment.closed_at, enrollment.created_at AS requested_at, wallet.balance AS accumulated_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_SVG_PAYHIST_H payment WHERE payment.saving_enrollment_id = enrollment.id AND payment.status = 'PAID') AS paid_count, enrollment.term_months AS total_payment_count FROM T_SVG_ENROLL_M enrollment INNER JOIN T_SVG_PROD_M product ON enrollment.saving_id = product.id INNER JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M wallet ON enrollment.wallet_id = wallet.id WHERE enrollment.child_id = #{childId} AND enrollment.status <> 'REJECTED' ORDER BY enrollment.created_at DESC, enrollment.id DESC

SELECT member.id AS child_id, member.teeny_score, grade.grade_id, grade.grade_name, grade.bonus_rate, grade.loan_rate FROM T_MBR_INFO_M member INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A grade ON member.applied_grade_id = grade.grade_id WHERE member.id = #{childId} AND member.role = 'CHILD' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_DPT_PROD_M ( fin_co_no, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, name, interest_calculation_type, rate_1m, rate_3m, rate_6m, rate_12m, early_termination_rate, min_amount, max_amount, description, is_active ) VALUES ( #{financialCompanyCode}, #{financialProductCode}, #{financialCompanyName}, #{name}, #{interestCalculationType}, #{rate1m}, #{rate3m}, #{rate6m}, #{rate12m}, #{earlyTerminationRate}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{description}, #{active} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kor_co_nm = VALUES(kor_co_nm), name = VALUES(name), interest_calculation_type = VALUES(interest_calculation_type), rate_1m = VALUES(rate_1m), rate_3m = VALUES(rate_3m), rate_6m = VALUES(rate_6m), rate_12m = VALUES(rate_12m), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
